_README: PILOT config. Eight cells, one per emotion x shape.
NOT STUDY DATA. These are hand-chosen values, not the output of Mengkai's sampling
and medoid aggregation. She is running that herself because her thesis has to
describe a process she executed. Do not analyse anything collected against this
file as study results, and do not let it substitute for her config.
What it IS for: building and verifying the Unity scenes, checking the rooms read
correctly in the headset, timing a full session, and filming demonstrations. All of
which can happen today rather than waiting.
Every value is inside the final pools, so this exercises the real gate. Separation
was checked with: python3 -m pipeline.cli check-separability

meta.purpose: pilot, scene verification and demos only
